Respondents For Petitioners : Mr. Rohit Sharma, Advocate For Respondent-State : Mr. Anmol Sharma, Panel Lawyer For Respondent No. 1 : Mr. Ramakant Mishra, Dy. Solicitor General along with Mr. Niraj Baghel, Advocate For Respondent No. 2: Mr. Dheeraj Kumar Wankhede, Advocate along with &6 Mr. Shreya Daga Chopda, Advocate SB: Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge ORDER ON BOARD 09/08/2024 1.

The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking following reliefs:-
"10.1
That, the Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to hold that, the impugned award is arbitrary and unjust.

10.2 That, this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to issue appropriate writ/order/direction and thereby direct the respondent authority to enhance the compensation award amount payable to the petitioners and/or direct the respondent to re-consider the compensation entitlement of the petitioners.

10.3 Grant any other relief(s)/ order(s)/ directions(s) in favour of the petitioner, which may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case, including awarding the cost to the petitioner."
2.

Learned counsel for the Respondents raises an objection that the petitioner is having alternate efficacious remedy of filing an applicatin seeking arbitration under the provisions of Section 3G (5)
of the National Highways Act, 1956.

3. After arguing for sometime, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in view of the objection raised by the counsel for the respondents, he may be permitted to withdraw this petition with liberty to avail the alternate remedy available under law.
He also submits that office be directed to return back the certified copies of the documents enclosed along with the writ petition after retaining the photocopies of the same.
